description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Extract text from a PDF (%PDF- magic, not Content-Type). Send exactly one of `url` (public http(s) link — egress GET, ≤ 20 MB) or `content_base64` (bytes you already have — the whole request body is capped at 1 MiB, base64 expansion included; optional `filename` labels the upload). Returns `pages` (per-page text), one concatenated `markdown` body, `title`, and `metadata`; $0.005 per document, not per page. `max_pages` limits extraction (default 50, max 200); documents over 200 pages or above your cap return 413 and are not billed. Scanned/image-only PDFs may return empty text with `billed: false` and a `hint`. Prefer readfetch_text or readfetch_scrape for HTML articles; readfetch_fetch for raw PDF bytes without extraction; readfetch_batch for many HTML URLs, not PDFs. Read-only server-side; paid x402 like other routes.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes. The request body is capped at 1 MiB total — base64 expansion comes out of that, it does not add to it (~0.75 MB of PDF). Mutually exclusive with url; pair with filename when the label matters.

filename.description: Optional label when using content_base64 (default upload.pdf); ignored for url-only requests.

max_pages.description: Extract at most this many pages. Default 50; raise up to 200 when the document is longer. Over cap → 413, unbilled.

url.description: Public PDF URL; fetched through egress (≤ 20 MB). Mutually exclusive with content_base64.

name: readfetch_pdf
